verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal publishes APIs from OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specs plus Markdown. The resulting portal lets developers browse and search API documentation and try operations, with public or private (authenticated) visibility. That covers generating and publishing docs from specs, which satisfies the story's "collections or specs" wording. Missing for 10: any evidence of doc generation from collections, depth on how docs are rendered or customized from specs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate and publish API documentation from my collections or specs

citations.quote: Dev Portal APIs allow you to publish APIs using OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specifications and Markdown documentation.
It enables developers to browse and search API documentation, try API operations, and manage their own credentials.
